# Quote service
GET /api/quote?symbol=ABC uses MARKET_API_URL from the environ argument. This in-memory handler makes no network request; the query price field supplies the price (default 12.5). A missing or empty MARKET_API_URL returns status 503 with {"error": "service unavailable"}.
